battle.name: 科林斯戰爭
battle.theater: 科林斯地峽與比奧西亞戰線
battle.brief: 公元前395年，底比斯等四城邦在波斯支援下起兵抗斯巴達，先戰於比奧西亞的哈利阿爾圖斯、科羅尼亞，後深入伯羅奔尼撒半島，前387年以《安塔西達斯和約》收場。卡面亞述長弓為前700年的複合弓，與本役相隔三百年，未現於希臘戰場；定勝負者是重裝步兵方陣與標槍圓盾，弓矢歸波斯海軍與輕步兵。

kit.name: 亞述長弓
kit.history: 亞述人靠弓和鐵的組合征服兩河流域。弓兵在車上射，車兵靠弓兵開路。

countries: 科林斯戰爭是前395年至前387年之間希臘世界的一場城邦聯盟對陣的戰爭，交戰主體是斯巴達及其主導的伯羅奔尼撒聯盟一方，與底比斯、雅典、科林斯、阿爾戈斯組成的四國聯盟一方；後者自開戰之初就得到阿契美尼德波斯王國在金錢與艦隊上的支持。聯軍方面的組織核心是底比斯：這座比奧西亞首府在戰爭爆發前已經以「三百人」奪取卡德米亞堡壘、驅走斯巴達的駐軍，並以每年輪替的「波伊塔爾科斯」集體執政制度調動盟邦兵員，聯軍最高作戰會議則設於科林斯城內。雅典提供海上力量與輕裝步兵，是聯盟中唯一保有獨立艦隊的成員，並在戰爭中重建了城牆。科林斯自前395年叛離斯巴達，交出城邦與港口雷凱烏姆，充當聯軍在伯羅奔尼撒半島的基地；阿爾戈斯與斯巴達有世代的邊境糾紛，帶來重裝步兵與本地騎兵。斯巴達一方以兩位國王阿格西萊二世與泡薩尼阿斯領銜，由各城的「哈莫斯托斯」與盟友的傭兵組成，重裝步兵的質量與伯羅奔尼撒的地利是其依仗。戰役同時在比奧西亞、科林斯地峽與愛琴海三個方向展開。
countriesEn: The Corinthian War was a war fought between city-state coalitions in the Greek world between 395 and 387 BC, the principal belligerents being Sparta together with the Peloponnesian League it led on one side, and a coalition of Thebes, Athens, Corinth and Argos on the other; the latter was backed from the opening of the war by the Achaemenid Persian Empire, which supplied money and ships. The organisational centre of the coalition was Thebes: before the war even began this Boeotian capital had seized the Cadmea with a band of the 'Three Hundred' under Pelopidas and expelled the Spartan garrison, and it now mobilised the allies through the collegial magistracy of the Boeotarchs, which turned over each year, while the allied war council sat in the city of Corinth. Athens provided sea power and light infantry, and was the only member of the coalition that retained an independent fleet; it rebuilt its walls during the war. Corinth had revolted from Sparta in 395 BC and handed over the city and its port of Lechaeum, serving as the coalition's base on the Peloponnese; Argos, which had generations of frontier trouble with Sparta, brought hoplites and its own cavalry. The Spartan side was headed by the two kings Agesilaus II and Pausanias, and was made up of harmosts in the individual cities and of mercenaries drawn from the allies, resting on the quality of its hoplites and on the ground of the Peloponnese. The war was fought simultaneously on three fronts: Boeotia, the Isthmus of Corinth, and the Aegean.
people: 主導這場戰爭走向的，是斯巴達國王阿格西萊二世與底比斯將領伊巴密濃達。前395年阿格西萊仍在亞細亞征討波斯，直到前394年才回師本土，先後在科羅尼亞迎戰底比斯，又於前388年率軍侵入阿提卡、包圍比雷埃夫斯，最後成為《安塔西達斯和約》的當事人。另一位斯巴達王里山德則死在前395年：他在底比斯被驅逐後北上救援奧耳科墨諾斯，於哈利阿爾圖斯兵敗陣亡，他的死同時消除了國內寡頭派中對阿格西萊的一股勢力。底比斯方面，佩洛皮達斯率「三百人」奪取卡德米亞，開啟了全戰；伊巴密濃達在前394年科羅尼亞以迂迴突擊大破斯巴達，但主戰記錄《希臘史》的色諾芬幾乎不提他的名字，其戰功多靠狄奧多羅斯、普布利尼等較晚的記載補上。雅典的關鍵人物是海軍統帥科農，他在前394年諾索斯海戰中擊潰斯巴達艦隊，隨後主持重建雅典的長城；伊菲克拉特斯改革輕裝步兵的裝備與打法，前391年在雷凱烏姆全殲斯巴達一個「摩拉」；卡布利阿斯則以夜襲攻破斯巴達營地。波斯方面，總督提沙費爾尼斯、法那巴佐斯與提里巴佐斯先後主持對希臘的介入，密使提莫克拉塔斯帶著金錢遊說雅典、底比斯與阿爾戈斯。色諾芬本人以雅典騎兵軍官的身份參與哈利阿爾圖斯之戰，後來寫成《希臘史》，成為這場戰爭唯一完整的同代記錄。
peopleEn: The man who shaped the course of the war was the Spartan king Agesilaus II together with the Theban general Epaminondas. In 395 BC Agesilaus was still in Asia Minor fighting the Persians and did not return to the mainland until 394; he met the Thebans at Coronea, invaded Attica in 388 BC and laid siege to Piraeus, and was one of the parties to the Peace of Antalcidas. The other Spartan king, Lysander, died in 395: after being driven out of Thebes he marched north to the relief of Orchomenus and was killed at Haliartus, and his death removed from Spartan politics the oligarchic faction that had been set against Agesilaus. On the Theban side Pelopidas led the 'Three Hundred' who seized the Cadmea and so opened the war, while Epaminondas routed the Spartans at Coronea in 394 with a flanking attack; yet Xenophon's Hellenica, the principal contemporary record of the fighting, barely mentions him, and his exploits have to be recovered from Diodorus, Plutarch and later testimony. The decisive Athenians were the admiral Conon, who destroyed the Spartan fleet at the Battle of Naxos in 394 and afterwards supervised the rebuilding of the Long Walls, and Iphicrates, who reformed the equipment and the fighting of peltasts and annihilated a Spartan mora at Lechaeum in 391; Chabrias won a night attack on a Spartan camp. On the Persian side the satraps Tissaphernes, Pharnabazus and Tiribazus directed the intervention in Greece in turn, and the agent Timocrates carried money to Athens, Thebes and Argos to stir them up. Xenophon himself took part in the battle of Haliartus as an Athenian cavalryman and afterwards wrote the Hellenica, the only complete contemporary account of the war.
kits: 卡面這件亞述長弓屬於前700年前後亞述帝國的工藝：一張短而角度分明的複合弓，弓身近乎直線、兩端向內反曲，張力靠角與筋的加固維持，箭矢短而輕。亞述人把它與鐵器綁在一起，弓手在戰車的平台上射擊、車兵靠弓手開路，這種「弓與鐵」的組合是兩河流域攻城拔寨的標準辦法。它與前395年的科林斯戰爭相隔約三百年，並不出現在這場戰爭的戰場上，放上卡面是為了標示一種遠東式的遠程火力解法。戰場上真正決定勝負的是重裝步兵：希臘人使用蒙皮內胎、外包青銅的圓盾，約二公尺半長的標槍，短至約六十公分的直刃劍，配青銅或硬皮胸甲、頭盔與脛甲，軍陣以十六乘八或更多橫縱隊展開。弓矢在希臘並非主流武器，重裝步兵依賴近身推盾與刺擊；真正用弓的是波斯與腓尼基海軍的射手、獵手出身的投槍者與伊菲克拉特斯的輕裝步兵，另有用鉛彈的投石索手與標槍手。攻城方面有撞擊槌、投石機與可移動的攻城塔，海戰則靠三列槳戰船的撞角、船首舷梯與登船用的海兵。聯軍一方還大量僱用各地傭兵，比奧西亞、阿爾戈斯與帖薩利都出過騎兵：聯軍騎兵在科羅尼亞的會戰中曾與斯巴達騎兵正面交手，阿提卡之役裡又以襲擾牽制斯巴達人，使圍困比雷埃夫斯的部隊不得不分心。
kitsEn: The Assyrian bow on the card belongs to the craft of the Assyrian Empire around 700 BC: a short, sharply angled composite bow, its belly almost straight and its tips recurving inwards, its tension held by horn and sinew, firing short light arrows. The Assyrians bound the bow to iron, and their archers shot from the platform of the war chariot, the chariot warriors following behind the archers; that combination of bow and iron was the standard way in which the cities of Mesopotamia were taken one after another. It stands about three hundred years away from the Corinthian War of 395 BC and did not appear on this battlefield; it is on the card to mark one far-eastern solution of the problem of bow and iron. What really decided the fighting was the hoplite: the Greek shield with a hide lining and a bronze rim, the spear some two and a half metres long, the straight-bladed sword of about sixty centimetres, a bronze or hardened leather cuirass, a helmet and greaves, and the phalanx drawn up in lines sixteen deep and as many files as the ground allowed. The bow was not a primary Greek arm; hoplites fought behind the shield and stabbed at close quarters. Arrows belonged to the Persian and Phoenician crews, to huntsmen serving as javelin-throwers, and to Iphicrates' light infantry, and there were also lead slingers and javelin men. The siege train included battering rams, stone-throwers and movable towers; at sea the business was done by the ram of the trireme, the boarding ladders and the marines. The coalition also hired large numbers of mercenaries, and cavalry came from Boeotia, Argos and Thessaly: the allied horse met the Spartan cavalry face to face at Coronea, and in Attica it harried the Spartans so that the force besieging Piraeus was forced to divide its attention.
tactics: 開戰的樣式是底比斯主導的多路並進：三個縱隊同時壓向比奧西亞與地峽，底比斯人一路由北進入比奧西亞，阿爾戈斯人、雅典人、埃布亞人與洛克里斯人自南面攻入，柯林斯人則向地峽推進，企圖切斷斯巴達人北上救援的通道。哈利阿爾圖斯一役是不利地形的守城反擊：底比斯人不與斯巴達人野戰，而是緊靠城牆列陣，用城垣遮蔽正面，待斯巴達軍展開後再出城反衝，里山德就是在衝向城牆時陣亡；雅典騎兵因為行軍遲滯被底比斯騎兵切斷退路，色諾芬率殘部殺出重圍。科羅尼亞一役是正面會戰：底比斯的左翼迂迴而前，右翼被斯巴達人擊散後，底比斯人反向的斜陣退卻，把散開的隊形重新收攏，斯巴達人雖然得手，卻沒能把戰果擴大。聯軍進入伯羅奔尼撒半島後改變打法，避免與斯巴達重裝步兵在開闊地交鋒，改用夜襲、斷糧、包圍斯巴達控制的城市與港口，輕裝步兵在遠處以矢石射擊，斯巴達人一逼近即遭遊擊，摩拉在雷凱烏姆的覆滅正是這種戰法的成果。海戰方面，諾索斯一役聯軍艦隊保持較遠的衝撞距離，並有腓尼基與塞浦路斯分艦隊加入，斯巴達高舷戰船在近身纏鬥中反而吃虧。阿格西萊前388年進入阿提卡後圍攻比雷埃夫斯，聯軍以馳援與騎兵襲擾迫其撤退。
tacticsEn: The war opened in a pattern of simultaneous advance led by Thebes: three columns pressed towards Boeotia and the Isthmus at once, the Thebans entering Boeotia from the north, the Argives, Athenians, Euboeans and Locrians coming up from the south, and the Corinthians pushing towards the Isthmus in the hope of cutting the road by which Spartans might come north to help. The battle of Haliartus was a counterattack from a defended position: rather than meet the Spartans in the open, the Thebans drew up their lines close to the wall, used the rampart to cover their front, and charged out only after the Spartan army had deployed; Lysander was killed as he ran up against the wall. The Athenian cavalry, delayed on the march, was cut off by Theban horse, and Xenophon led the survivors out. Coronea was a set-piece meeting of two armies: the Theban left advanced in a flanking movement, the Theban right was broken by the Spartans, and the Thebans then withdrew in an oblique formation, gathering their disordered ranks as they went, so that the Spartans gained the field but could not enlarge the result. Once inside the Peloponnese the coalition changed its method, refusing to meet the Spartan hoplites in open country and using night attacks, cutting of supply lines and the besieging of the cities and ports held by Sparta; light troops shot from a distance and withdrew when the Spartans closed, and the destruction of the mora at Lechaeum was the fruit of that method. At sea the allied fleet kept its rams at a longer distance and was reinforced by Phoenician and Cypriot squadrons, and the high-decked Spartan ships were at a disadvantage in the close melee. After Agesilaus entered Attica in 388 BC and besieged Piraeus, the coalition came to the relief of Athens and harried him with cavalry until he withdrew.
data: 可依據的數字大致如下。戰爭自前395年起，至前387年《安塔西達斯和約》簽訂為止，前後約八年，部分紀年計至前386年。哈利阿爾圖斯之役，斯巴達方面投入約一千名重裝步兵與少量騎兵，底比斯方面約二千名重裝步兵並有騎兵配合，里山德陣亡，雙方各有數百人被殺。色諾芬記載阿格西萊二世渡海赴亞細亞時所部約有一萬名重裝步兵，另有數千輕裝步兵與一支投石手部隊，這支部隊後來成為斯巴達在本土作戰的骨幹。前394年9月的諾索斯海戰中，斯巴達艦隊全滅，海軍統帥佩桑德羅陣亡；同年稍後的科羅尼亞會戰，斯巴達王阿格西萊二世本人參戰。前393至前392年間，雅典的長城重建完成。前391年伊菲克拉特斯的輕裝步兵在雷凱烏姆消滅斯巴達一個「摩拉」，約三百人，這是斯巴達步兵建制中少數被整個殲滅的案例。距離上，底比斯至哈利阿爾圖斯直線約四十餘公里，科羅尼亞在底比斯以西約七十五公里；斯巴達「摩拉」編制約三百人，希臘方陣的基本單位為十六乘八。
dataEn: The figures that can be given on good authority are roughly as follows. The war began in 395 BC and ran to the Peace of Antalcidas in 387, about eight years, though some chronologies carry it on to 386. At Haliartus the Spartans committed about a thousand hoplites and a small body of horse, and the Thebans about two thousand hoplites with cavalry of their own; Lysander was killed and several hundred men fell on each side. Xenophon records that when Agesilaus II crossed to Asia Minor he had about ten thousand hoplites with him, together with several thousand peltasts and a body of slingers; that force later formed the core of the Spartan army at home. In the naval battle of Naxos in September 394 the Spartan fleet was destroyed and its commander Peisander was killed; at the meeting of Coronea in the same year the Spartan king Agesilaus II fought in person. Between 393 and 392 BC the Long Walls of Athens were rebuilt. In 391 BC the peltasts of Iphicrates annihilated a Spartan mora, about three hundred men, at Lechaeum, one of the rare occasions on which a unit of the Spartan order was wiped out entire. In terms of distance, Haliartus lies a little over forty kilometres from Thebes in a straight line and Coronea about seventy-five kilometres to the west of it; a Spartan mora was about three hundred men, and the basic block of the phalanx was sixteen men deep and as many files wide.
cause: 導火線是斯巴達的霸權本身。伯羅奔尼撒戰爭結束後，雅典的帝國被斯巴達瓜分，出力最多的盟邦所得最少，怨氣在科林斯、底比斯與阿爾戈斯之間累積；斯巴達又長期干涉比奧西亞各城的人事，安置寡頭、驅逐民主派，使底比斯人把斯巴達視為比波斯更直接的敵人。前395年春天，底比斯趁裸足競走祭之際由佩洛皮達斯率三百人奪取卡德米亞、驅走駐軍，聯軍隨之形成。更深一層的原因是波斯的算盤：波斯要在亞細亞把阿格西萊的斯巴達軍趕走，卻不甘心讓雅典人坐大，於是總督法那巴佐斯派密使提莫克拉塔斯帶著金錢遊說雅典、底比斯與阿爾戈斯，承諾以波斯金錢支撐他們的戰爭；呂底亞總督提沙費爾尼斯因未能支持這場戰爭而被處死。戰局在戰爭中途逆轉：阿爾塔薛西斯二世的兄弟小居魯士在前394年1月的庫納克薩戰役中陣亡，波斯轉而扶持斯巴達，用《安塔西達斯和約》拆散聯軍。
causeEn: The spark was Sparta's hegemony itself. After the Peloponnesian War the Athenian empire had been divided up by Sparta, and the allies that had done the most of the fighting received the least, so that resentment accumulated in Corinth, Thebes and Argos alike; and Sparta had interfered for years in the affairs of the Boeotian cities, installing oligarchs and driving out democrats, until the Thebans came to regard Sparta as a more immediate enemy than Persia. In the spring of 395, while the festival of the naked footrace was being held, Pelopidas led the Three Hundred into the Cadmea and drove out the garrison, and the coalition took shape. At a deeper level there was the Persian calculation: Persia meant to drive Agesilaus' Spartan army out of Asia, yet was unwilling to let the Athenians grow strong, so the satrap Pharnabazus sent the agent Timocrates with money to Athens, Thebes and Argos, promising that Persian funds would pay for their war; the satrap of Lydia, Tissaphernes, was executed for failing to support it. The situation then turned in the middle of the war: Artaxerxes II's brother Cyrus the Younger was killed at the Battle of Cunaxa in January 394, and Persia switched its weight to Sparta, breaking up the coalition through the Peace of Antalcidas.
impact: 這場戰爭沒有實現聯軍公開的目標，卻把希臘世界的權力版圖重新畫了一遍。斯巴達在海上的霸權就此崩解：艦隊覆沒之後，愛琴海的島嶼陸續脫離控制，雅典人藉著戰時的金錢與盟邦的困境重建長城，重新取得海上位置，卻沒有能力獨力建立新的帝國。比奧西亞與伯羅奔尼撒的城邦在戰後獲得《王和約》所保證的自治，聯盟體系被拆散，各自為政；聯軍內部的裂痕也在和約的談判中完全暴露，底比斯主張的、比奧西亞霸權隨即成為阿卡迪亞同盟打倒斯巴達的前奏。波斯方面，這是阿契美尼德王朝第一次以仲裁者身分介入希臘城邦的戰爭，《安塔西達斯和約》開了由國王頒布國際條約的先例，此後的比奧西亞和約與公元前362年的最後和約都循此模式。戰爭也把希臘世界推向以傭兵為主的時代：此役的絕大部分兵力由各地傭兵組成，而色諾芬在戰後所寫的《希臘軍遠征記》正是這批傭兵的親歷記錄。史家方面，色諾芬的《希臘史》幾乎是唯一的同代記載，卻明顯偏袒斯巴達，提及的偏頗使佩洛皮達斯與伊巴密濃達的事功都無從在書中復原；出土於俄克喜林庫斯的紙草《俄克喜林庫斯希臘史》則提供了另一種較為持平的記載。
impactEn: The war did not achieve the aim its authors proclaimed, but it redrew the map of power in the Greek world. Sparta's maritime empire collapsed: with the fleet destroyed, the islands of the Aegean slipped out of its control one after another, and the Athenians, with the money of the war and the embarrassments of their allies, rebuilt the Long Walls and recovered a position at sea, though without the strength to build a new empire of their own. In Boeotia and in the Peloponnese the individual cities received the autonomy guaranteed by the Peace of the King, the old league systems were broken up, and every city stood on its own; the fissures inside the coalition were laid bare during the peace negotiations, and the Boeotian hegemony that Thebes had claimed became the pretext for the Arcadian League's assault on Spartan power. On the Persian side this was the first time the Achaemenid dynasty intervened in the wars of the Greek cities as arbiter: the Peace of Antalcidas set the precedent of an international treaty proclaimed by a Great King, and the Boeotian peace and the final settlement of 362 BC followed that model. The war also pushed the Greek world towards an age of mercenaries, since the great mass of the armies in it consisted of hired troops from many places, and the Anabasis that Xenophon wrote afterwards is the record of one such band from the inside. On the documentary side, the Hellenica of Xenophon is very nearly the only contemporary account and is openly biased towards Sparta, and that bias is why the deeds of Pelopidas and Epaminondas cannot be recovered from it; the papyrus of the Oxyrhynchus History of Greece, dug up at Oxyrhynchus, provides a fuller and more even-handed record.
result: 前387年（部分紀年作前386年）簽訂的《安塔西達斯和約》，是這場戰爭的終點，也是它的實質結果。條款由波斯總督提里巴佐斯居中提出：希臘各邦彼此自治，只有斯巴達人自己的土地除外，國王與各邦均須獨立自主。這份和約對聯軍是一紙失敗的宣言——聯盟被解散，斯巴達的盟邦各自回國；對底比斯打擊最重，它被迫放棄比奧西亞聯盟與盟主的地位，科林斯與阿爾戈斯保住了自由城邦的地位；對斯巴達則是承認與合法化，它沒有被徹底削弱，卻以自治的名義把自己對外支配的關係洗成合法同盟。戰役層面的勝負亦已分明：斯巴達損失了里山德與整支海軍，卻在比奧西亞與阿提卡的陸戰中守住了地盤；聯軍奪回了比雷埃夫斯與愛琴海的部分航路，卻沒有能力把斯巴達人逐出伯羅奔尼撒。真正終結斯巴達霸權的戰爭要再等二十多年，前371年成立的阿卡迪亞同盟與前362年的曼丁海戰才完成這一步。科林斯戰爭留下的，是一個仍然以斯巴達為中心、卻已佈滿裂痕的希臘秩序。
resultEn: The Peace of Antalcidas, concluded in 387 BC (in some chronologies 386), is the end of the war and at the same time its real result. Its terms were put forward by the Persian satrap Tiribazus: the Greek cities were to be autonomous with one another, save for the lands of the Spartans themselves, and king and peoples alike were to be independent. For the coalition the document was a declaration of failure: the league was dissolved and the Spartan allies went home each to his own city. It struck Thebes hardest, which had to give up the Boeotian League and the position of hegemon; Corinth and Argos kept the standing of free cities. For Sparta it was recognition and legitimation: the order was not destroyed, but its relations of external domination were laundered into a lawful alliance. The issue of battles is equally clear. Sparta had lost Lysander and its whole fleet, yet held its ground in Boeotia and Attica; the coalition had retaken Piraeus and part of the sea lanes of the Aegean, yet had not the strength to drive the Spartans out of the Peloponnese. The war that finally ended Spartan hegemony lay more than two decades ahead, in the Arcadian League founded in 371 BC and the Battle of Mantinea in 362. What the Corinthian War left behind was a Greek order still centred on Sparta but already shot through with cracks.
